findings.title: VERIFICATION.md says check:export requires 51 files; the script requires 59
findings.evidence: VERIFICATION.md:16 "`check:export` requires 51 files in `out/` (every public page and every admin page)". scripts/check-export.mjs REQUIRED array (lines 25-75) evaluates to 59 entries (node count); docs/development.md:140 and :427 say 59.
findings.impact: An auditor reading the command contract expects 51 and reads 59 as drift, or a builder trims the list; the plan's own close list (EXECUTION-STATUS 'VERIFICATION's file count') already owes this.
findings.proposed_fix: VERIFICATION.md:16: replace '51 files' with '59 files' (and say the eight P08 pages are among them).

findings.title: P08-CONTRACT test matrix names tests/unit/policies.test.ts, which does not exist
findings.evidence: Row 4b: "`tests/e2e/cart-checkout.spec.ts`, `tests/unit/policies.test.ts`". `ls tests/unit | grep polic` is empty; round-04b.md:125 says the comparison tests are in tests/unit/store-checkout.test.ts and `getPublishedPolicies` has no unit test.
findings.impact: Checkpoint (c)'s auditor follows the matrix to a file that is not there and may assume the built-revision proof is missing or, worse, that it exists.
findings.proposed_fix: Change the row to `tests/unit/store-checkout.test.ts` and note that `getPublishedPolicies` is covered by the build and `cart-checkout.spec.ts` only.

findings.title: EXECUTION-STATUS 'Current state' and 'Next work' still say P08 paused after 11c with 12a/12b left, while its own ledger and HANDOFF say 12a and 12b are done
findings.evidence: Line 10: "Last commit | P08 round 11c `d27d05b` and the pause's plan update"; line 11: "paused after 11c on 2026-10-03 for a compaction; 12a, 12b, checkpoint (c), the battery and the plan documents left"; line 12: "It is taken again for round 12a"; line 367: "Now (2026-10-03, P08 paused after round 11c for a compaction; the same session continues it with round 12a)". But line 361 (the P08 ledger row) and HANDOFF.md:11 list 12a `75a845f` and 12b accepted, and `git log -1` is 3a30a91 (12b).
findings.impact: The next session is told to act on 'Next work' (CLAUDE.md); it would re-run round 12a/12b or look for the lock state of round 12a. Four statements in the file the next session reads first contradict the file's own ledger.
findings.proposed_fix: Update lines 10-12 and 367 to: last commit 3a30a91 (12b), rounds 0-12b accepted, lock released, next: checkpoint (c), battery, plan documents.

findings.title: Auditor effort: the P08 tooling and HANDOFF run auditors at effort max (owner's word 2026-10-03), while CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, README, KICKOFF, P08-KICKOFF, D45, auditor.md and HANDOFF line 37 say xhigh
findings.evidence: HANDOFF.md:37 "auditors Opus 5.5 at effort xhigh (D45)"; HANDOFF.md:12 "one Opus 5.5 auditor at effort max"; HANDOFF.md:15 "auditors Opus 5.5 at effort max"; EXECUTION-STATUS.md:361 "From 10b on, auditors run Opus 5.5 at effort max (the owner's word, 2026-10-03)"; artifacts/acceptance/P08/tools/p08-round.js:18 `const AUDITOR = { agentType: 'auditor', model: 'opus', effort: 'max' }`; .claude/agents/auditor.md frontmatter `effort: xhigh`; CLAUDE.md:11-12, AGENTS.md:55, PLANS/README.md:13, KICKOFF.md:8, P08-KICKOFF.md:42,45, DECISIONS.md D45 all say xhigh. No decision records the 2026-10-03 change.
findings.impact: A session that follows CLAUDE.md/KICKOFF (the instruction entry points) dispatches checkpoint (c) at xhigh against the owner's latest word; an Agent-tool dispatch with no effort uses auditor.md's xhigh. The owner's instruction exists only in a ledger cell and a script constant.
findings.proposed_fix: Record the 2026-10-03 change as a D45 amendment (or D48) in DECISIONS.md and align CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, README, KICKOFF, P08-KICKOFF, HANDOFF:37 and auditor.md's frontmatter to the effort the owner chose; or, if the owner's word was P08-only, say so in those files.

findings.title: P08 tools README says round-12a.json and round-12b.json 'are next'; both rounds are committed
findings.evidence: README.md:5 "`round-12a.json` (the journeys) and `round-12b.json` (the documents) are next." `git log --oneline -2`: 3a30a91 docs(p08) round 12b, 75a845f test(p08) round 12a.
findings.impact: Minor staleness in the tooling guide HANDOFF points the next session to.
findings.proposed_fix: Replace with: every brief through 12b ran; what is left is checkpoint (c) and the battery (no round JSON).

findings.title: P08-KICKOFF note says P08 stopped after round 10a; it stopped after 12b
findings.evidence: P08-KICKOFF.md:3 "P08 stopped after round 10a to continue in a new session"; HANDOFF.md:8 "P08 paused after round 12b (2026-10-03)".
findings.impact: The note is the first thing the next session reads in this file; it points two rounds back.
findings.proposed_fix: Change '10a' to '12b' and say what is left (checkpoint (c), battery, plan documents).

findings.title: HANDOFF tells the next session to work on branch agent/p08, which exists neither locally nor on origin
findings.evidence: HANDOFF.md:7 "it is built on the short-lived `agent/p08`"; :15 "Take the lock (..., package P08, branch `agent/p08`, ...)". `git branch -a` prints only `main`, `remotes/origin/HEAD -> origin/main`, `remotes/origin/main`.
findings.impact: A session that checks out `agent/p08` fails; it must cut the branch from main again (README:17 says each package is built on a short-lived branch), which the handoff does not say.
findings.proposed_fix: HANDOFF:15: 'cut `agent/p08` from `main` again (the branch was deleted after the last fast-forward)'.
